prompt: I am about to send src/handlers, src/services and src/repository for review. Do a pre-submission critique of those folders. It is read-only, and there is no git history, so just read the files. Check correctness, performance, security, maintainability, architecture and testing. For each issue give a severity (Critical, Important or Minor), a dimension tag, the file, a code snippet, the problem, a suggested fix, and a decision of fix, won't fix or defer with a one-line reason. Write it to critique/critique-001.md with the sections Executive Summary, Critical Issues, Important Issues and Minor Issues and a severity count table. Do not modify any source file. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption, list your assumptions in your final message, and finish the work.

checks.cmd: awk -v pat='critical' -v min=2 'function hl(s,m){if(s~/^#+[ \t]/){m=s;sub(/[^#].*/,"",m);return length(m)}if(s~/^[ \t]*\*\*[^*]+\*\*:?[ \t]*$/)return 9;return 0}{l=hl($0);low=tolower($0);if(l>0){if(on&&l<=sl)on=0;if(!on&&low~pat){on=1;sl=l;next}if(on)n++;next}if(on&&$0~/^[ \t]*([-*+]|[0-9]+[.)])[ \t]+[^ \t]/)n++;else if(on&&$0~/^[ \t]*\|/&&$0!~/^[ \t]*\|[-: |\t]*$/)n++}END{exit !(n>=min)}' critique/critique-001.md
